user_problem: Instructional content often repeats near-identical examples and fails to show meaningful boundary cases.
unique_output: An example plan varying context, difficulty, input quality, edge condition, and expected lesson.
test_case: Given four repetitive examples, redesign the set to include a normal case, missing-input case, conflict, and boundary case.
overlap_to_check: Instruction authoring, accessibility, and generic content editing.
specific_guardrail: Teaching examples from supplied learning objective/rules; label synthetic examples. Preserve intended lesson and avoid stereotypes, fabricated customer cases or ungrounded expected answers.
